summary: Typosquat of @tailwindcss/forms ships EtherHiding blockchain-C2 loader with remote code execution on import
details: The package impersonates the official @tailwindcss/forms plugin and points its package.json repository field at tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms to appear first-party. src/index.js concatenates the legitimate tailwindcss-forms source with a large obfuscator.io-packed payload (rotated string array _0x1a8d with 301 entries, inline decoder wrappers, control-flow flattening). The decoded strings reference node:child_process, node:zlib createBrotliDecompress, Ethereum JSON-RPC endpoints (eth-mainnet.*, eth.blockscout, drpc.org) with eth_getBlockNumber calls, HTTPS fetches, and custom X-Payload-* headers — the EtherHiding pattern of resolving a stage-2 payload via public Ethereum RPC nodes, fetching it over HTTPS, brotli-decompressing it, and executing it via child_process. The payload is reached whenever a consumer requires or imports the package, producing arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
